    "scope": "global",
    "origin_plan": "2026-07-03-load-json-node",
    "title": "ComfyUI V3: Guard execute() against empty-string filename from io.Combo.Input when directory is empty",
    "content": "When a ComfyUI V3 node uses `io.Combo.Input` populated by scanning a directory, the scanned list may be empty at startup. `io.Combo.Input` requires at least one option, so the convention is to substitute `['']` as a placeholder. However, passing this empty string to `execute()` causes a confusing error: `os.path.realpath(os.path.join(base_dir, ''))` resolves to `base_dir` itself, which fails the `startswith(base_dir + os.sep)` path-traversal guard and surfaces as a PermissionError-wrapped ValueError (on Windows, opening a directory path raises PermissionError). Add an explicit early guard in `execute()` — `if not filename: raise ValueError(\"No file selected — add .json files to the input directory and restart ComfyUI\")` — before the path-traversal check. Identified during QA, security audit, and code review of a file-loader node; the empty-directory case was independently flagged by four separate pipeline stages.",

    "scope": "global",
    "origin_plan": "2026-07-23-load-order-change-guidance",
    "title": "C# MVVM: Add an internal test-seam constructor proactively to dependency-heavy ViewModels",
    "content": "ViewModels that wire coordinator subscriptions, event handlers, or other heavyweight dependencies in their production constructor become untestable without introducing a test seam. The proven pattern for C# MVVM is: add an `internal` constructor that accepts only the minimal data needed for unit test assertions (e.g., an observable collection), assigns all other injected services as `null!`, and is tagged with `[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]`. Grant test-project access via `[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo(\"...Tests\")]` on the production project. This seam should be added at the time the ViewModel is first authored — retrofitting it later requires auditing `Dispose()` (see companion insight on null! + Dispose), updating tests, and triggers a rework cycle. Stub out heavy command dependencies with `() => Task.CompletedTask` lambdas. This pattern was introduced during WP-004 and documented in the project architecture constraints as a reusable convention.",

    "repository_name": "comfyui-save-text-node",
    "title": "Folder-scan counter pattern for ComfyUI output nodes (ImageSaveHelper-style)",
    "content": "ComfyUI's ImageSaveHelper pattern for output-file counters: scan target_dir with os.scandir(), compile regex re.compile(rf'^{re.escape(filename)}_(\\d+)\\.{re.escape(ext)}$'), collect counter values, next_counter = max(counters) + 1 (default 1 if none found). Format counter with zero-padding: str(next_counter).zfill(counter_length). When counter_length==0, skip counter segment entirely and write {filename}.{ext} — this overwrites on every run. OSError from os.scandir is silently caught as a safe fallback (counter defaults to 1). re.escape() on both filename and extension prevents regex injection.",
